device: Agent_Emulator_Narrow (360x640 dp, 1080x1920, gesture nav, swangle_indirect software GL)
build: flutter build apk --profile --target-platform android-x64; launched with --ez enable-impeller false
gesture: swipe from x=8 px (2.7 dp) rightward 700 px
note: Android gesture navigation takes the swipe: the system back indicator follows the finger, the page does not track, PopScope closes it with the 400 ms animation on release
recorder: adb screenrecord; frames extracted at the container's own timestamps (frames are emitted only when the screen changes, ~15 fps under software GL)
